verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an Export API for raw event data (amplitude-docs-12), a Dashboard REST API returning JSON for analytical queries (amplitude-docs-30), behavioral cohort export APIs (amplitude-docs-29), and an HTTP V2 ingestion endpoint (amplitude-docs-2), backed by a discoverable OpenAPI spec (amplitude-probe-3). This covers both querying and raw data export via documented APIs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the export/query APIs' reliability and completeness, and more detail on rate limits/pagination for large-scale pulls.
